verdict.rationale: Serving embedding models is a fair question for a local model-serving tool like Ollama, but nothing in the evidence mentions embedding models, an embeddings endpoint, or retrieval/search use. The REST API (ollama-gh-4) and OpenAI-compatible subset (ollama-docs-12) are described only generically. The community remark about "embedding them into our product" (ollama-comm-14) refers to integrating LLMs into a product, not to vector embeddings.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve embedding models for retrieval and search applications
